turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
, most orders ship within 48 business hours, and tracking is usually sent once the order ships. After that, delivery is typically:

US: 3 to 7 business days
Canada: 8 to 14 business days
International: 8 to 14 business days

If this was placed during a holiday or promo period, shipping confirmation can sometimes take up to 5 business days. You can also track it here once tracking is available: https://glamnetic.com/pages/track-my-order 😊
